We interviewed and surveyed 136 automotive executives
across various roles and markets to gain insight into
the industry’s perspectives on experience innovation
— from the challenges it creates to the opportunities
it presents — and the strategies OEMs may employ to
enhance customer experience and drive growth.
Information on the respondents’ qualifications and
experience is shown here. We only interviewed experts
and executives who were familiar with their companies’
CX initiatives and actively involved or influential in their
companies’ or clients’ digital innovation projects.
